units.source_text: 我们顺利地考完试后，夫人也为我们高兴，她说，你们俩只剩下最后一年了。

en.t: After we finished our exams successfully, Madam was happy for us too, and she said, you two have only one final year left.

units.source_text: 而唯一令夫人自豪的小姐，不久也要毕业了。

en.t: And the young lady, the only one Madam was proud of, would soon graduate as well.

units.source_text: K对我说，女人就是这样，什么都不懂就出了学校门。

en.t: K told me that women were like that: they left school without understanding anything.

units.source_text: 他似乎根本不把小姐在课外学习的缝纫、抚琴、插花等功课放在眼里。

en.t: He seemed to take no account at all of the lessons Miss was studying outside school, such as sewing, koto, and flower arrangement.

units.source_text: 我笑他太迂腐，又在他面前老调重弹，宣称女人的价值并不在这里。

en.t: I laughed at him for being so old-fashioned, and in front of him I repeated my old argument, declaring that a woman's value did not lie in such things.

units.source_text: 他倒没有表示反对，但也没露出赞成的意思。

en.t: He did not object, but he showed no sign of agreeing either.

units.source_text: 这让我很高兴，因为他那不以为然的口气说明他仍旧看不起女人，因为他不把我奉若女人之花的小姐当回事儿。

en.t: This made me happy, because his dismissive tone showed that he still looked down on women, and because he did not take seriously the young lady whom I revered as the flower of womanhood.

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，那时我对K的嫉妒心就已经萌芽了。

en.t: Looking back now, my jealousy toward K had already begun to sprout at that time.
